findings.claim: The delegated waiting-set comparison uses the raw queue state (Entries, StateWaiting), while the engine's barren stop names landing run --goals over pending, which also drops waiting entries already on origin/main.
findings.evidence: batch.go:196-200 compares against Entries with StateWaiting; stop.go:340-351 builds Required from pending; queue.go:548-572 marks entries already on main as landed. A delegate that copies the stop's --goals is refused with a message telling it to repeat with every waiting goal; this fails closed and can be recovered.
findings.change: No change in this unit; U1b1c sources the delegate's goals from the same raw waiting set, or a later unit compares against pending.
findings.relation: rule: one definition of the waiting set a delegate must name

findings.claim: lane.BarrenHeld restates the held rule the status view already applies instead of the view calling it.
findings.evidence: view.go:126-138 (BarrenHeld) and view.go:176-184 (ownerView) both test Barren >= barrenLimit and fingerprint == BarrenFingerprint.
findings.change: Optionally have ownerView use BarrenHeld's rule so the two cannot drift; equivalent today.
